caption:
The haze in my head was supposed to be the city's exhaust, but the video doesn't lie. The white room and that look of pity are the only things that feel real, even if they prove the rest of my life is just a well-crafted script. I’m keeping the cartridge. Let them think I’ve forgotten. 🌃

Eve keeps the cartridge, but the weight of the truth begins to rewrite her sense of belonging.
